title: Niagen Bioscience to Present at Canaccord Genuity’s 46th Annual Growth Conference
summary: Niagen Bioscience, Inc. (NASDAQ: NAGE), the global authority on NAD+ (nicotinamide adenine dinucleotide) with a focus on the science of healthy aging, today announced that its Chief Executive Officer, Rob Fried, and Chief Financial Officer, Ozan Pamir, will participate in Canaccord Genuity’s 46th Annual Growth Conference, taking place from August 11 to 13, 2026, in Boston. Mr. Fried is scheduled to participate in a fireside chat on Tuesday, August 11, at 2:00 p.m. Eastern Time (11:00 a.m. Pacific Time). To register for the Niagen Bioscience fireside chat webcast, please visit www.event.summitcast.com . Mr. Fried and Mr. Pamir will also hold one-on-one meetings with institutional investors throughout the conference. To arrange a meeting, please contact your CG representative or email Niagen@KCSA.com .
